facts: PlayerWork contains a serialized SaveData.playerParty and a separate nonserialized _playerParty runtime field.
PokeParty contains PokemonParam[6] m_member followed by uint m_memberCount.
PokemonParam inherits m_coreData, m_calcData and m_accessor; its full serialized size is 344 bytes.
CoreParam data is 328 bytes and CalcData is 16 bytes; CalcData contains level and maxHp.

demonstrated_conclusion: The previously monitored SaveData.playerParty is a serialized copy and is not the live HP authority. For this exact SP 1.3.0 profile, PlayerWork._playerParty is the unique coherent runtime party and is reachable through the demonstrated singleton chain at field offset 0x808.
not_yet_demonstrated: A live HP transition through this runtime source.
Party reorder lifecycle through this runtime source.
